answer: Resist Sybil attacks by rationing admission through a verifiable random lottery each epoch. Applicants post a refundable bond, then a public beacon draws a fixed quota of winners, while the rest wait for a later round. The draw signal is published for anyone to verify, so a swarm cannot flood entry at once, and each fake identity still costs a bond plus waiting time. Like a comet that appears only on schedule, admission arrives rarely and unpredictably, so an attacker must pay and wait repeatedly to grow many identities, while honest newcomers face only one fair draw.
